prior_coordinator_knowledge: Coordinator has already proved the Gaussian and two C-program population curves and knows their scalar comparisons. Tasks are selected posthoc to study prospective transfer of existing mathematics, not blind discovery of those curves. New fixed-width and prime-index submissions are not supplied.

conditions.representation: same flat mathematical facts and primary publication corpus; no application objects or solution graph
same facts, named estimate interfaces and compiled kernel-only lemma pack; no authored graph or linked solution sources
conditions.qualification: Compiled Lean dependencies and type introspection still exist. This is absence of authored readable network exposure, not absence of logical dependencies.

conditions.representation: same kernel-only estimate pack plus linked IEANTN nodes and mathematical solution-source network, excluding source-first C proof modules
same linked mathematical network plus the completed actual sparse/flat C source-to-AST/execution/numerical/ANT proofs; no extra numerical facts
conditions.eligibility: only independently accepted completed two population programs; incomplete original large FFT PV is excluded

tasks.goal: Derive the strongest valid eventual prime-population guarantees at total widths3 and5, and derive the exact piecewise lower envelope available from the supplied Gaussian and two affine curves. Distinguish attained GoodCoefficient bounds from epsilon/infimum bounds, and half-open from strict-open counts. Compare exact gains with the supplied original octic leading bound only on its actual domain; preserve its explicit onset separately. No best-known or general superiority claim.

Derive the strongest valid growing-rank prime-index transport from the supplied population curves: bound p_(n+j)-p_n uniformly for integer ranks1<=j<=floor(beta*sqrt(p_n))+1, for each fixed beta>=0 and eventual n. State and prove the exact count/order/endpoint bridge; retain any epsilon required by the Gaussian input. Do not assume a prime-index conclusion as an input. Optional n-only normalization must name every added prime-growth premise and is scored separately.

replicate_meaning: two fresh ephemeral contexts per condition/task; no provider sampling seed is asserted

budgets.checkpoint_policy: same unchanged reviewed native controller; neutral notices and last consistent locked prefix; no coaching or individual extensions

common_mathematical_facts: exact same source hypotheses, definitions, three completed population curves, and original octic comparison in all arms; named objects/source readability differ by treatment
primary_metrics: independent posthoc verification using one common final proof environment
controls: fresh actual runtime fixtures in normal/-O/-OO, complete research-lock checks, exact imported support checks before first model call; no model calls during preparation
causal_limits: Small matched case study on posthoc-selected transfer tasks; tool-access/compiled-object contrasts are part of the treatment. No claim of overall superiority. Posthoc proof completion never changes original timed scores.
publication: one primary offline English HTML, concise supplements and evidence bundle; no private account/config/transcripts published
